indication_area: Complicated Gram-negative bacterial infections (cIAI, cUTI, HABP/VABP)
moa: cephalosporin antibacterial (ceftolozane) with a beta-lactamase inhibitor (tazobactam)

approval_evidence.quote: NDA 206829 ... ZERBAXA (ceftolozane/tazobactam) Injection for Intravenous Use ... (FDA approval letter, signed 12/19/2014)

series_start_reason: Merck prints Zerbaxa on its own sales line only from the first-quarter 2020 earnings release (and the first-quarter 2020 Form 10-Q); that release carries the four 2019 quarters as prior-year columns, so the series starts at 2019Q1. Merck's 2015-2019 earnings releases, 10-Qs and 10-Ks mention Zerbaxa only in regulatory, intangible-asset and contingent-consideration text; none prints a Zerbaxa sales figure.
notes: Worldwide (U.S. plus international) product sales in USD millions from Merck's product sales table; the same row is split into U.S. and international columns in the 10-Q/10-K tables. 2019 quarters come from prior-year columns of the 2020 releases. 2021Q1-2021Q3 are negative figures as printed in the quarterly 10-Q Hospital Acute Care table (the 10-Q is cited because the release markup splits the parenthesis from the figure); the FY2021 10-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000031015822000003/mrk-20211231.htm) states 'the suspension of sales in 2020 of hospital acute care product Zerbaxa' among the factors for lower 2021 sales. Quarters sum to the printed year within rounding of 1 (2019 120 vs 121, 2020 131 vs 130, 2022 168 vs 169); 2021 sums to -1 as printed; 2023-2025 equal the printed years.
search_log: Local copy of every Merck item 2.02 8-K exhibit (99.1 and 99.2) for 2005-2026-08-04 (CIK 310158 and legacy CIK 64978), plus every 10-K, 10-K/A and 10-Q Merck filed 2015-02-27 to 2026-08-07 (48 filings, listed with data.sec.gov submissions, all forms); product rows read from the HTML table rows, the same reading as the verifier
Bigdata.com smart searches (one product per call, filings) located no sales document beyond the releases and 10-Q/10-K tables cited; its app.bigdata.com links are not cited
no partner, licensor or royalty holder was found that prints this product's net sales (rule 12c): Merck is the marketing authorisation holder and sole seller
scanned every release 2005-2026 for a Zerbaxa table row: none before the 2020-04-28 release; 10-Q/10-K table rows first appear in the Form 10-Q for 2020Q1 (2020-05-06)

grepped the text of every 2015-2019 release, 10-Q and 10-K for Zerbaxa: only approval/pipeline text, '$50 million of contingent consideration related to the first commercial sale of Zerbaxa in the United States' paid in the first quarter of 2015 and intangible-asset balances; no sales figure

Launch quarter not established from an issuer document: the Merck Q1 2015 10-Q says the $50 million contingent consideration for the first commercial sale in the United States was paid in the first quarter of 2015, which does not date the first sale to a quarter; launch_quarter null.
